## Release requirements

Before merging:

- [ ] CI passes
- [ ] `VERSION` is correct
- [ ] Release type is identified
- [ ] Required maintainer approval is present
- [ ] Required waiting period has elapsed, if applicable
- [ ] Blocking objections have been resolved

## Approval / timing

For minor releases:

- [ ] 48 business-hour lazy consensus window completed

For major or breaking releases:

- [ ] At least two maintainer approvals
- [ ] 1 week objection window completed

For emergency releases:

- [ ] Emergency reason documented
- [ ] At least one other maintainer approved
